summary: Website and online store builder; Commerce APIs manage products, orders, inventory and profiles on a merchant site.
access_note: API keys for custom apps need the Commerce Advanced plan; OAuth for multi-site apps requires registering and getting an OAuth client approved.
blocker_note: OAuth client must be reviewed and approved by Squarespace before connecting other users' sites; single-site API keys need a paid plan.

evidence.quote: Depending on your development needs, you can use a generated API key or start the OAuth process with Squarespace to become a registered OAuth client.
With Squarespace's Commerce Advanced plan, you can develop a custom application for a Squarespace merchant site.
Registering an OAuth client, and having it reviewed and approved, only allows OAuth connections with Squarespace.
All Commerce APIs are built on HTTPS and designed with REST principles in mind.
The Squarespace MCP server is a remote server.
Your MCP client connects directly to: Code https://mcp.squarespace.com/mcp

notes: Official remote MCP server exists (domains tools need no sign-in; commerce tools need Squarespace sign-in and are limited to Claude and ChatGPT clients per the docs at time of reading). API keys need the Commerce Advanced plan; OAuth clients need Squarespace review.

review.reason: Squarespace publishes a remote MCP server at https://mcp.squarespace.com/mcp (developer docs MCP section); pass 1 found only third-party ones. Commerce tools need sign-in and are currently only in Claude and ChatGPT.
